## Critical Tests per Story

### CASCADE-006 (~20 tests)
Key: C1b counterintuitive proof (delta(40) > delta(10)), C0 convergence to equilibrium 70 over 20 ticks, C1b boundary at F_q=75 uses safe-high branch (R3 fix).

### CASCADE-007 (~20 tests)
Key: C2 noise-bound across 1000 seeds (|delta-base| ≤ 1.0), rng injection pattern for all noisy chains, C0+C3 additive composition test.

### CASCADE-008 (~18 tests)
Key: C4 counterintuitivity proof (both extremes negative, sweet spot positive), C4 reads prevState.staff_morale NOT accumulated delta (Rule 3 critical), oscillation edge case over 2 weeks.

### MATCH-SIM-001 (~10 tests)
Key: worldStateDeltas exactly 2 keys (AC-MATCH-05), substitution_window excluded from MatchOutcome.events (AC-MATCH-30).

### MATCH-SIM-002 (~8 tests)
Key: round-trip determinism across pause boundary — ctx1[0..44] + ctx2[45..89] = ctx3[0..89] (AC-MATCH-02 cornerstone). seedrandom pinned exactly.

### CASCADE-009 (~18 tests)
Key: C16b guard skip on non-match weeks (log entry 'guarded'), C16a always fires, C5b|delta| > C5a|delta|.

### MATCH-SIM-003 (~12 tests)
Key: F1 clamp to 0, F2 weight sensitivity (±0.35 per skill), emergency GK stat derivation.

### MATCH-SIM-004 (~12 tests)
Key: rng() called exactly once per momentumDelta tick (vi.fn spy — critical for AC-MATCH-01/02), 3-5-2 amplifier home-only.

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off:

1. `tsc --noEmit` passes (new requirement from retro A3)
2. Full vitest suite passes (all 143 Sprint 01 tests remain green after new chain implementations)
3. CASCADE chain formulas C0 + C1a + C1b + C2 + C3 + C13 + C4 replace placeholder transferFns that previously threw
4. runTick pipeline with real edges produces bounded WorldState (no NaN, no out-of-range values)
5. PRNG round-trip: pause@45 + resume === single-pass (AC-MATCH-02)

## Definition of Done — Sprint 02

A story is DONE when:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified via automated test result
- [ ] Test file exists at `packages/shared/tests/[cascade-engine|match-sim]/[story-slug].test.ts`
- [ ] 0 test failures in the full vitest suite
- [ ] `tsc --noEmit` clean (zero errors)
- [ ] Smoke check passed (`/smoke-check sprint`)
- [ ] QA sign-off APPROVED (`/team-qa sprint`)
- [ ] Story file updated to Status: Complete via `/story-done`
